faq: Will you get my account reinstated?
We cannot promise that, and nobody honestly can, because Amazon decides. We prepare a clear, truthful appeal that deals with the exact reason given, which gives a request its best chance.
Do you submit false documents or fake invoices?
Never. We use only genuine invoices, records and facts you provide. If something cannot be proven, we say so and write the appeal around what is true. Fake documents can end an account for good.
How fast do I need to act?
As soon as possible, because some notices have deadlines. Send us the notice text and the date you got it, and we put those cases first. Amazon sets its own review times.
Do you set up extra accounts to get around a block?
No. Amazon allows one seller account per business in most cases, and we do not set up extra accounts to work around a block. That would put your main account at risk.
desc:
Amazon account health and policy warnings need a calm, factual response. Ecom Swift LLC reviews your Account Health dashboard, finds the real cause of each notice, fixes the listing or process behind it, and drafts an honest plan of action for you to submit.

## Why does Amazon account health matter?

Account health is the set of signals Amazon uses to decide whether a seller may keep selling. It includes order defect measures, late shipment and cancellation measures, policy compliance, listing issues and intellectual property complaints. When these signals drift, Amazon can remove listings, hold funds or suspend selling privileges, and each of those stops income.

Many sellers first notice a problem when an email arrives. By then the clock is running, and a rushed reply that blames the buyer or hides the facts usually makes things worse. A measured, documented response gives the reviewer something they can act on.

## How good account care protects your results

Healthy accounts keep listings live, keep the Buy Box available and keep payouts moving. A warning left unanswered can turn into a suppressed listing, and a suppressed best seller means lost orders every day it stays hidden.

The mechanism is simple. Amazon reviewers read many appeals, and they look for three things: that you understand what went wrong, that you have fixed it, and that it will not happen again. A plan of action that covers those points in plain language is easier to approve than a long emotional message. Amazon makes every decision, and we cannot promise reinstatement or a particular outcome.

## What a solid account health clean-up includes

- A review of the Account Health dashboard, including every open warning and notice.
- A written root cause for each issue, not just a description of the symptom.
- A fix list for the listings or processes that caused the problem.
- A plan of action with root cause, steps taken and prevention.
- A checklist of the supporting documents that each case needs.
- Corrections to listing details such as titles, images, claims or condition notes.
- A policy prevention checklist for your team or supplier.
- A weekly check routine so new warnings are caught early.

## How we work through your notices

We begin with a read of the dashboard and each message from Amazon, in the order they arrived. We sort them by urgency, because a suspension notice and a listing-level warning need different handling. For each one we trace the cause back to something real: a supplier invoice mismatch, a product claim, a late shipping pattern, a complaint about authenticity.

We make the fixes that are ours to make in your account, then write the plan of action for you to read and submit. Everything we write is based on your real documents. The Basic, Standard and Premium packages cover a growing number of issues and drafts, with the largest adding a prevention checklist and a weekly health routine.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Read the full notice before replying and answer what it actually asks.
- Gather real invoices, supplier letters and test reports early.
- Describe the root cause honestly, even when it is your own mistake.
- Fix the listing or process first, then write the appeal.
- Keep a record of every message and date.

**Avoid:**
- Sending edited or invented documents of any kind.
- Opening a second account to work around a block.
- Copying an appeal template without changing the facts.
- Blaming buyers or Amazon staff in the message.
- Waiting several weeks before responding to a notice.

## Who this is for

This service suits a seller who has just received a policy warning and does not know where to start. It also suits an owner whose listing was removed for a claim or authenticity complaint and who needs a fix list before reappealing. A growing brand with several sellers or helpers can use the prevention checklist to keep everyone working to the same rules.

## What we need from you

Please send screenshots or copies of each warning, the dashboard view, and any documents that relate to the products involved, such as supplier invoices or certificates. You invite us as a user in your Seller Central account with the permissions needed to view account health and listings. We never ask for your password, and we never submit documents that are not genuine.
